summary: community.okd k8s removed merge_type=json in 4.0.0. Use kubernetes.core.k8s_json_patch instead.
questions: How do I apply a JSON patch to an OpenShift resource now?

answer_card.title: JSON patch in community.okd k8s
answer_card.answer_md: `merge_type=json` was removed from community.okd's `k8s` in 4.0.0. Use `kubernetes.core.k8s_json_patch` for JSON patches.
